requirement_text.GH#2682: Exam content snapshot at session start; scoring reads only the snapshot (PR a). CODE gate review of commit ff42bea87.

task.description: SECURITY-REVIEWER code gate for REQ-511 PR a against INV-1..INV-8 and design R1-R6/A1-A5. Read-only; no mix run.

result.summary: PASS (code, PR a). In scope: tenant-data path (session/exam scoring, migrations-equivalent definition rollout, restriction rows), plus the Stamp gate and config key. No BLOCKER found. ANSWER-KEY CONFIDENTIALITY: exam_snapshot is written only into session.field_values in the create call (session.ex materialize_session); session_view/1 is a hand-built map (no field_values), session_state_json/session_view_json hand-built, exam_row_json serves exam rows only; PUT/POST echoes are the caller's own sent values; the restriction pair {session, exam_snapshot} is in Exam.@answer_key_fields (seeded by on_install and reconciled by Exam.ensure_answer_key_restrictions + Rollout), and start fails closed 503 when the active session definition lacks the json field or the restriction row is absent (session.ex check_snapshot_prerequisites). Event/instance exposure stays closed by merged #2702 (synthetic ids 404 on every Instances route), unchanged by this diff. No log line carries snapshot, digest, nonce or key values: router render_snapshot_failure logs the tag, the path session id and the tenant prefix; Rollout/Release/mix reports carry tags and counts only. SNAPSHOT BUILD: Snapshot.build_from_resolved validates threshold (nil -> threshold_missing; unparsable or outside 0..100 -> threshold_invalid) and normalises through Decimal to a string ('60', '60.00', 60, 60.0 all -> '60'); builds only the resolved ids (Map.take(sources, order)); correct option ids come from is_correct == true rows, sorted; likert keys complete or fail; 16-byte CSPRNG nonce; SHA-256 over a canonical key-sorted encoding computed over the decoded value; 2 MiB cap -> snapshot_too_large. Digest is accident detection only (OQ-12, accepted in step-06). SCORING/AUTOSAVE/STATE: score_and_persist reads Snapshot.fetch_verified + to_scoring_questions + threshold + session_answer only; build_scoring_inputs, build_question_row, passing_threshold_for, the 60.0 fallback and polarity_atom are deleted (grep: no Latest.get exam, no query_all question/answer_option in any scoring path). Autosave takes the type from the snapshot (item missing maps to :question_not_in_session). State read for an in_progress session requires a structurally valid snapshot (strict) and takes the TYPE from it; question stem and option text/ids remain live display reads, is_correct and likert fields are never selected (unchanged hand-selection). Terminal sessions are lenient (snapshot item if present, else the live type, no write, no error) and PR a has no late path, so a terminal session never gets a snapshot. update_session_after_submit merges the outcome into the locked row's own field_values (snapshot carried forward). TYPED ERRORS: {:grading_error, reason} and {:snapshot_error, reason} each have their own clause in render_start_session, render_get_session_state, render_autosave, render_submit and render_report_event ahead of the catch-all; bodies are constants (D-6), 500 for grading, 503 for snapshot; reasons contain atoms and question uuids only and reach only Logger. R6 ownership-before-prerequisite: autosave (fetch_session, check_owner, in_progress, deadline, session_question, then snapshot), submit and finalize (lock_session_row, owner check, then scoring), state read (fetch_session, check_owner, then snapshot) and report_event (AntiCheat owner check, then Session.submit) all authorize before any snapshot read; non-owner and nonexistent run the same single lookup so bytes and query count match (Router maps :session_not_found and :not_owner to Response.not_found). LOCK ORDER (A5, evidence the dev handoff did not quote; I grepped lib for FOR UPDATE / advisory): PR a adds NO new lock acquisition. Pre-existing order is preserved: create = exam row (lock_exam_row) -> Records.create_record(session) [instance sequence of the session type -> audit chain] -> session_question writes; submit/finalize = session row (lock_session_row) -> session_question_score writes -> Records.update_record(session) [instance sequence -> audit]. The only new code before the writes in create is read-only (Definitions.get_active_definition_by_name, Repo.exists? on entity_field_restrictions, Latest.get on pinned questions). lock_exam_row is called only from create_txn and lock_session_row only from submit/finalize; no path found that takes the audit-chain or instance-sequence lock and then a session or exam row lock. Rollout takes only definition-row locks (Definitions.create/activate) and restriction inserts, never an exam or session row lock. ROLLOUT: reaches definitions only through Definitions.create_definition/3 and activate_definition/4 (no direct entity_definitions write), tenant_id only from TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name(schema), actor is the nil-UUID system actor (RecordDeadlineSweep precedent), unknown definition keys/values fail with a tag instead of being dropped, managed types are reported (managed_cannot_upgrade) not written, one transaction per tenant, lock/statement timeouts set via parameterised set_config (INV-7: constant text, bound parameter), reports are tags and counts. STAMP GATE: :exam_snapshot_complete read only via Application.get_env(:letflow, :exam_snapshot_complete, false) != true in Stamp.gate_closed?; false in config/config.exs, true only in config/test.exs; no runtime.exs, System.get_env or put_env use in lib; run/1 checks it before the sweep and run_tenant/2 before anything else, so Release.ManagedTypes.stamp/1, the mix task and a direct run_tenant call are all refused; any dry_run value other than literal true is treated as a real run; dry runs allowed; mix task exits 1 on {:error, :snapshot_not_complete} and on gate_blocked_total > 0. PR a contains no PR b component (no late snapshot, no certificate facts, no cutover rule, no flag flip, no Stamp prerequisites). #2612: NOT triggered by config.exs (the diff adds only the :exam_snapshot_complete key; the :modules line is unchanged context); no ci.yml/cd.yml/mix.exs/permission_matrix/authorization.ex/catalog.ex/priv/permission_matrix path touched; this review satisfies the mandatory SEC trigger anyway. Not run: mix test or mix compile (read-only review, no mix); behaviours above are from reading the code and the dev's compile/format/boundary results.

invariants_assessed.INV-4: APPLIES - PASS. No secret introduced; snapshot, digest, nonce, answer ids never logged or returned; Logger and reports carry tags, uuids and prefix only; grep for hardcoded secrets found none (the nil UUID is an actor id, not a secret).

See advisories.

evaluations.D-2: SAFE AND SOUND. The old build_question_row built likert_options for every option of a likert question via to_float/polarity_atom, which raised (FunctionClauseError) on a nil weight or polarity at submit time. Requiring a complete non-empty likert_options map at START makes the same defect a typed start failure instead of a crash at submit, i.e. strictly more fail-closed, and only the questions actually drawn are validated (Map.take). single/multiple/truefalse needing a correct option matches Scoring's :question_without_correct_option; shorttext needing nothing matches Scoring. The literal design text ('every non-shorttext question needs a correct option') would have made every likert exam unstartable and is the wrong reading; CDV/REVIEWER should amend design 7.2/T-17 to the implemented rule. Re-validated at read time in to_scoring_questions so a tampered or hand-built snapshot cannot reach Scoring with an empty likert map.
evaluations.D-4: ACCEPTED. Catalog.fetch + two Exam delegates is the sanctioned route under check_boundaries rule 5 (the same route Stamp uses for the exam manifest); the dev reported 0 violations. No new exposure: the delegates run the same Rollout functions. Design file layout should be amended.
evaluations.D-5: ACCEPTED. Nil-UUID system actor follows lib/letflow/scheduler/record_deadline_sweep.ex:140; created_by/activator_user_id are NOT NULL; the audit trail shows an unmistakable system actor rather than a forged human. Residual: the artifact_activations migration should be confirmed to carry no FK on activator_user_id (not verifiable without running; test T-37 will exercise a real rollout).
evaluations.D-6: ACCEPTED. All grading bodies are one constant string, start one constant string, every snapshot_error one constant 503 string; no id, reason or value in any body. 500 for grading versus 503 for snapshot differs but discloses only tenant-wide rollout/system state, not another candidate's data.
evaluations.manual_pin_non_active: ACCEPTED, fail closed. A pin whose question is missing or not active now fails the START with {:question_not_found, id} (generic 500 with a constant body, id only in the log) instead of silently scoring a retired question. Availability cost only: one retired pinned question blocks that exam's start until the pin is fixed; REVIEWER may prefer a mapped 4xx.
evaluations.ticket_2612: Not triggered by this diff (config.exs gains :exam_snapshot_complete only, :modules untouched); the mandatory SEC review is satisfied by this report.

advisories: ADV-1 (INV-8, low, non-blocking) lib/letflow/modules/exam/session.ex fetch_pinned_question_row/2 (~l.1003): Latest.get/3 casts the pin's question_id as a uuid; a malformed non-uuid string in exam_manual_question.question_id would raise Ecto.Query.CastError during start (500 via the plug, transaction rolled back) where the old fetch_option_ids path returned a typed result. The value is admin-authored and fk-declared, not candidate-controlled; a cheap Ecto.UUID.cast guard returning {:question_not_found, id} would close it. Can be taken in PR a or PR b.

ADV-2 (consistency, non-blocking) session.ex snapshot_question_type/2 (~l.1110): a snapshot that lacks an item for a question that HAS a session_question row is reported as :question_not_in_session instead of a grading error; it is a corrupt-snapshot signal and would be better as {:grading_error, {:question_item_missing, id}} so the 500/log path fires. Body is constant either way, no leak.
ADV-3 (process) the dev handoff step-08 does not quote the A5 lock-order grep evidence the design required; this report supplies it (summary, LOCK ORDER). Add one line to the PR body.

ADV-4 (hygiene) commit ff42bea87 also modifies two files of another run (handoffs/WF02-GH2702-INSTANCES-SYNTHETIC-20261017/step-07-security-reviewer-code.json and step-08-reviewer-code.json); not a security matter, but confirm they belong in this PR (one PR per issue).

ADV-5 (PR body, as already ruled) in-flight in_progress sessions without a snapshot cannot be scored or autosaved after PR a deploys until PR b ships the late path; finalize_expired for them returns a typed error and the sweep retries. State this in the PR body. Rollout must run immediately after deploy; until it runs every exam start answers 503.

ADV-6 (tests, for TEST-DESIGNER) T-30 per A1, T-61 variant per A3, T-63 query-count parity per A4 remain required in the test phase; the seed/fixture and live-edit expectations listed in step-08 existing_tests_expected_to_need_updates must be updated, including test/support fixtures that build sessions without exam_snapshot.
